name: Cyber Specialists
description: Turn vulnerability descriptions and threat-report sentences into structured answers for security workflows. The CVSS specialist returns a vector, score and triage route; the ATT&CK specialist suggests technique labels.
summary: Classify vulnerability severity and suggest ATT&CK techniques from security text.
